sources.source: Matillion: Tech note — SAP note 3255746 impact on SAP ODP data extraction

items.item: SAP Note 3255746 restricts third-party use of the RFC modules in the SAP ODP framework specifically, first published in 2022 as unsupported-use guidance, then tightened in version 4 (2 February 2024) to an outright prohibition, then updated again on 7 July 2024 to point customers at SAP Datasphere

at.step: SAP's own note, stated precisely

items.item: SAP's rules also name SLT Replication Server, an ABAP adapter, HANA log-based replication and SAP Database Trigger as technologies that must not move data out of SAP

at.step: Four mechanisms, four different things they can actually see

items.item: RFC as a protocol, and table/CDS view extraction, DeltaQ, BAPIs and function modules all remain fully usable — only the ODP Data Replication API over RFC in SAP-to-non-SAP scenarios is restricted

at.step: Before the mechanisms: what actually changed here?

sources.source: DEV Community: CDS and SAP Datasphere

items.item: CDS views are written in a SQL-like language enriched with annotations and relationships, add meaning through hierarchies and associations, and can be published as OData services

at.step: Raw tables, and the semantic layer built over them

items.item: On 13 February 2025, Databricks and SAP announced SAP Databricks, natively integrated into SAP Business Data Cloud, with bi-directional Delta Sharing and Unity Catalog governance, sold by SAP

at.step: The vendor-preferred path, and a named outside partner

items.item: SuccessFactors' OData API uses asOfDate/fromDate/toDate to control which version of an effective-dated record a query returns; a record outside its effective start/end date relative to that date is filtered out entirely, not returned stale
